60fb01a24795a6000762fe83: Aspheera arrives at the Monastery of Spinjitzu and confronts Wu, forcing one of the ninjas to make a heroic sacrifice.
Having learned Zane is not dead, Master Wu prepares to go after him, but Lloyd and the other ninjas take matters into their own hands and defy their Master.

The ninjas arrive in the Never-Realm, where they quickly find themselves overwhelmed; luckily, they are taken in by a tribe of Ice Fishers who tell them Zane has been imprisoned by the evil Ice Emperor.

Lloyd runs afoul of the Ice Emperor's Blizzard Samurai but is rescued by a strange wolf, with whom an unlikely friendship develops.
Back in Ninjago City, three criminals learn of the ninjas' absence and stage a breakout of Kryptarium Prison, telling tall tales of how they were captured as they go.
Lloyd and his wolf companion find a cave with the mech inside and a message from Zane that provides a clue to his fate.

Guilt-ridden over having lost the Traveler's Tea, Cole embarks on a dangerous quest to the top of a nearby mountain in hopes of finding the legendary Traveler's Tree, a tree which is supposedly guarded by a fearsome beast.
Cole awakens inside an icy cavern belonging to a legendary beast and attempts to escape, only to discover a surprising truth.
The Ice Emperor summons an enormous ice behemoth to attack Lloyd and his faithful wolf companion.

The Ice Emperor's terrible Ice Dragon strikes again and lays waste to the Ice Fisher's village, forcing the ninjas to go after Lloyd.

The story of Zane's arrival in the Never-Realm and how he fell under the sway of the villainous Vex.

Nya, Jay, Cole and Kai face off against the Ice Emperor's dreaded dragon, while Lloyd and his newfound allies, Kataru and Grimfax, confront the Ice Emperor himself.
The dramatic conclusion of the Never-Realm saga, in which old friends are reunited and the power of friendship is pitted against the corrupting power of the Scroll of Forbidden Spinjitzu.

The ninja race back to the Monastery of Spinjitzu. This is the last stand. The final battle against the Oni is now. Will their joined Spinjitzu powers defeat the Oni for good, or tear apart Ninjago itself?

As NINJAGO City rebuilds, Faith arrives with a dire warning: the Oni have returned and are destroying the realms, one by one. NINJAGO must prepare, and Lloyd must face the possibility that to defeat this foe, he may need the help of another enemy.
Having freed Lord Garmadon from Kryptarium Prison, the ninjas are beset by doubts, particularly about Lloyd. Lord Garmadon and Lloyd journey into the cloud of darkness to stop the Oni's invasion.

The Oni in Ninjago City are stronger than anyone could have imagined, and the ninja must risk a daring rescue of Lloyd and Garmadon. Though there is still a slight hope, one ninja will pay a terrible price.
While investigating a heist, the ninja discover Prime Empire, an unreleased arcade game that suddenly takes control of all other games in Ninjago
When the ninja connect Jay's disappearance to Prime Empire, they set out to Dyer Island to seek answers from the game's designer, Milton Dyer.
Cyrus Borg discovers a secret about Prime Empire while the ninja battle an escaped Mechanic in an attempt to reach Level Thirteen and enter the game.
Inside Prime Empire, the ninja are in unfamiliar territory, ignorant of the rules, as they try to find Zane and escape Unagami's Red Visors.
Inside one of the game zones, a Samurai named Okino faces a crisis of faith when he  fails to lead a series of Masters to victory.
In order to stop Unagami, the ninja must obtain 3 Key-tanas, the first of which is hidden in Terra Karana–one of the most dangerous game environments.
The ninja climb the 'Cliffs of Hysteria and discover that Unagami is converting players into energy cubes to build a portal into the real world.
Still in the game zone Terra Karana, Okino has to choose between helping his allies the ninja, or obeying the evil orders of his Master, Unagami.
The ninja learn that the only way to acquire the 2nd Key-tana is by winning a race in Terra Technica and have to find racing cars in unexpected ways
As the ninja prepare for the brutal Speedway Five-Billion race, Lloyd meets a race driver named Seven who may hold the key to victory.
Unagami's soldiers, the Red Visors, finally discover the secret location of Scott's garage and attack the ninja.
Our ninja barely have time to mourn the loss of their fallen ninja friends before being thrust into the madness of Terra Domina.
Back in Ninjago City, Zane and Pixal hit the mean streets to track down Milton Dyer, only to discover that things are not what they seem...
Zane, kidnapped by the Mechanic, faces Unagami while Pixal questions Milton Dyer for information on how to shut down Prime Empire.
Jay must stand alone against Unagami in the end-game, yet Unagami has a bigger battle in facing the truth about his own identity.
Unagami breaks into the real world and terrorizes Ninjago City while Jay, Zane and Pixal attempt to prevent disaster by reuniting Unagami with Dyer.
The ninja are invited to attend the birthday party of Princess Vania in the Kingdom of Shintaro. They bring along Master Wu who is feeling his age.
Princess Vania reveals a secret entrance that leads to an underground mine beneath Shintaro where the city's dark secrets are held.
The ninja attempt to rescue Cole, but the bickering of his fellow prisoners  alerts the Skull Sorcerer, and soon the ninja are prisoners too.
In order to escape the Skull Sorcerer's chain-gang, the ninja must convince the Munce and Geckles to put aside their distrust and work together.
Jay, Nya and Lloyd are led into the Mines of Shintaro by Murt who brings them back to the Munce "Home-Cave". The Munce Queen takes a liking to Jay.
A party of Geckles suspect Kai and Zane of being in league with the Skull Sorcerer and bring them to their leader who subjects them to a Trial-By-Mino
Separated from the others, Cole must find his way to the surface to alert King Vangelis of the dangerous Skull Sorcerer.
An entire episode chronicles how Cole, Princess Vania and Master Wu fall down a seemingly endless tunnel, into the bowels of Shintaro Mountain.
Cole, Wu and Princess Vania befriend a motley group of survivors, called the Lowly, and are told the story of how they too ended up at "Rock-Bottom."
Having joined forces with the Lowly in their quest to defeat King Vangelis, Cole, Wu, and Vania have to find a way out of the bottom of the mountain.
Nya and Kai, who have become the leaders of the Munce and Geckles, try to unite the tribes and defeat their mutual enemy, the Skull Sorcerer.
Cole, Princess Vania, Wu & the Lowly arrive at a temple in Shintaro Mountain which was once a training ground for Earth Elementals incl. Cole's mother
The ninja, the Munce and the Geckles take refuge in the Geckle Strong-Cave about to confront the Skull Sorcerer and Grief-Bringer.
Cole, the Lowly, Princess Vania and Wu blast their way out of the mountain to confront the evil Skull Sorcerer!
Cole and the Upply arrive to rescue Lloyd and the ninja. To do so, Cole will need to retrieve his mother's fabled swords, the Blades of Deliverance.
The battle for the fate of Shintaro Mountain concludes!
An expedition led by Misako, Master Wu and Clutch Powers goes missing while exploring an uncharted island and the ninja must pick up their trail...
Having survived their journey to the island, the ninja venture inland, where they unexpectedly befriend a dragon and are ambushed by living statues!
The ninja find themselves captured by the 'Keepers of the Amulet', who seem to be treating Jay particularly well. Meanwhile, Lloyd stages a rescue.
As Jay is sacrificed to the sea serpent that terrorizes the island, the other ninja begin to suspect events on the island are not all as they seem...
When Nya loses control of her elemental powers, the ninja must search for answers, which may lie with the former Master of Water – Nya's mother.
Nya's mother, Maya, arrives with advice on how to regain control of Nya's powers. Meanwhile, Zane and Pixal discover that something else may be behind the disturbances.
The ninja embark on a mission to uncover the source of a mysterious power signal that is disrupting marine life and Nya's powers.
Nya and Maya discover the source of the energy pulse that has been disrupting Nya's powers and come face-to-face with a dangerous new villain.
Nya and her mother Maya attempt to escape from the evil Prince Kalmaar, who schemes to overthrow his father, the benevolent King Trimaar.
Prince Kalmaar deceives the Merlopians and turns the ninja into fugitives.

The tragic tale of Benthomaar is revealed, a tale filled with treachery, betrayal, but also with a glimmer of hope.

Kalmaar awakens Wojira and sets his sights on the destruction of NINJAGO City.
The ninja do all they can to evacuate the city as King Kalmaar's assault on the surface world of Ninjago begins.

Un mutante que tiene la capacidad de interfase con cualquier computadora con su mente, que queda paralizado después de un encuentro con el equipo, se hace cargo de las computadoras de Sanctuary.

Al descubrir que su compañera de equipo Lexa es objeto de un experimento encubierto que la está controlando, el equipo de Mutante X busca al médico responsable.

Dylan se hace cargo de una barcaza turística en un intento de escapar de mercenarios.
Una identificación del cuerpo sale mal cuando resulta que el ex compañero de tripulación de Beka no está muerto en absoluto.
Andrómeda rescata a la gente moribunda de una deriva, pero pronto se convierten en zombies siendo controlados por una mente colmena.
El motor de la creación es capaz de reescribir el universo de acuerdo con los deseos del propietario. Dylan, Beka y Trance deben obtenerlo antes de que alguien con planes oscuros lo reciba.
642d4493aa2d690008f0a03f: Mai has rebounded from her previous loss to Joey to become a better duelist. Has Yugi learned from his loss to Kaiba, or is the emotional defeat still weighing on his heart? The answer is in the cards!

Joey searches for the card that permits him to enter the final battle, not realizing Bandit Keith has stolen it. As he struggles to accept the fact that Serenity will be blind forever, he receives help from a new friend!

After Bandit Keith's Machine deck forces Joey to take the defensive, Joey mimics Keith's battle strategy to metallize his Red Eyes Black Dragon! Is victory assured, or does the cheater Bandit Keith literally have one last card up his sleeve?
Yu-Gi-Oh!: Beste Freunde, harte Gegner, Teil 1
Joey challenges Yugi for the right to face Pegasus. In a battle between friends, a fierce match ensues between the two people who know each other's strategies and cards.
Yugi is shocked as Joey uses the Time Wizard card on him. It's the very same card Yugi gave Joey as a sign of friendship!
Yugi prepares for the ultimate battle against Pegasus with the souls of Grandpa, Kaiba and Mokuba on the line.

Pegasus punishes Yugi using the same Toon Deck and mind-reading abilities he used on Kaiba. As Pegasus turns Yugi's monsters against him, Yugi loses the will to battle. Will Pegasus capture Yugi's soul into a card, just like Kaiba?

Yugi has found a counter to Pegasus's mind-reading ability: Yugi switches back and forth between his two souls! Yugi is able to destroy Pegasus's Toon World, but the duel has just only begun. The next level of the deadly Shadow Game is about to start!

Yugi crumples under the power of the Shadow Game. His friends yell desperate encouragement, but their voices cannot penetrate the sphere of darkness. Yugi's chance at victory is slipping away, as is his life!
Pegasus summons Relinquished , a fearsome monster that can consume Yugi's Duel Monsters! Yugi counters with... Kuriboh?
Yugi meets a mysterious Egyptian named Shadi who enters Yugi's mind with the Millennium Key. What are these Millennium Items, and do they hold the answer to the mystery behind the Shadow Games?
Yugi and friends return from the Duelist Kingdom only to meet a young girl named Rebecca who demands that Grandpa return Blue-Eyes White Dragon to her.

Rebecca mistakenly believes that Grandpa stole the Blue Eyes White Dragon from her grandfather. Yugi must defend the Blue Eyes White Dragon to teach her that it's not the power of the cards, but the heart that's in them that counts.
The two-faced Board of Directors of Kaiba Corporation trap Kaiba inside a virtual reality game. Mokuba recruits Yugi and Joey to free Kaiba from this ultimate game where losing equals death!
The quest for Kaiba continues with a little help from... Mai? But can YUGI and friends adapt to a virtual world where the rules and strategies keep changing every step of the way?
Yugi and friends rescue Kaiba, but they are still stuck in the game! The only exit is past a Five-Headed Dragon, but in the difficult duel, Joey, Mokuba, and Mailose all their life points!
Duke Devlin defeats Joey and humiliates him in public, forcing Yugi to challenge Duke to a duel. However, this will not be a Duel Monsters duel, but a new game named Dungeon Dice Monsters!
In exchange for Joey's freedom, Yugi agrees to give up Duel Monsters forever if he loses. Unfamiliar with the rules, Yugi gets off to a rough start.

Yugi uses his innate gaming skills to turn the tables on Duke, but Duke has one more rule to mention: All creatures take up territory on the grid-like board. With no room to summon any new monsters, Yugi's position is helpless!
After Duke's all-powerful Orogoth The Relentless dices Yugi's entire cadre of monsters into shreds, Yugi only has one turn left before he loses all his heart points!
An arcane fortune teller steals the Millennium Puzzle and Yugi must defeat him in a duel to win it back.

The mysterious menace controlling Bandit Keith shatters the Millennium Puzzle into pieces before setting the dueling arena ablaze. Can Yugi put the Millennium Puzzle back together and save the spirit before the entire room is engulfed in flames?
The origin of Duel Monsters is revealed. Using the magic of the Millennium Necklace, Egyptian historian Ishizu Ishtar shows Kaiba how Duel Monsters was played millenniums ago.
The spirit of the Millennium Puzzle realizes that his memories of ancient Egypt have faded, but Tea helps him uncover the mysteries of his past.
Yugi learns that he was a powerful Pharaoh who saved the world five thousand years ago, and he must now save the world again.
Yu-Gi-Oh!: Dem Jäger in der Falle
Joey is cornered by a group of sinister Rare Hunters who force Joey into a duel. If he loses, the Rare Hunters get his precious Red-Eyes Black Dragon!
It's time to master new rules and monsters; let the Battle City Tournament commence! In the first duel of the tournament, Yugi challenges the Rare Hunter to win back Joey's Red-Eyes Black Dragon.

Yugi figures out the Rare Hunter's strategy to summon the almighty Exodia, but it's too late to stop him. The Rare Hunter already has four pieces of Exodia in his hand, and the fifth and final piece is on top of his deck.

The psychic duelist Espa Roba defeats Rex Raptor as easy as a chumpasaurus, and Joey's next on his hit list. What chance does Joey have when Espa Roba has the telepathic ability to read all the cards in Joey's hand?
Joey discovers that Espa Roba's extrasensory perception was a hoax, that he's not yet free from Espa's mental manipulations.
Yu-Gi-Oh!: Der Meister unter den Zauberern (1)

The magician duelist Arkana transports Yugi to the world's most lethal dueling arena where the loser gets sent to the Shadow Realm. Yugi must win this duel or he'll lose much more than his Dark Magician.
Yu-Gi-Oh!: Der Meister unter den Zauberern (2)

It's Dark Magician versus Dark Magician! However, while Yugi only controls one Dark Magician, Arkana has three residing in his deck. Though outnumbered, Yugi will never give up as long as he believes in the heart of the cards.
Yu-Gi-Oh!: Der Meister unter den Zauberern (3)
To counter Arkana's Dark Magician, Yugi pulls a rabbit out of his hat: the Dark Magician Girl!
The trickster Weevil Underwood spins a web of lies to bait Joey into a lopsided duel.

Joey swats Perfectly Ultimate Great Moth only to have Weevil let loose the ferocious Insect Queen, the crown jewel of insects that grows in strength for every creepy crawler it cannibalizes. Will Weevil's royal ravager swarm Joey into submission?
Yugi faces off against another of Marik's nefarious Rare Hunters, the silent but deadly Strings.
Strings summons one of the most powerful creatures in the history of Duel Monsters: the Egyptian God Monster Slifer the Sky Dragon!

Junte-se à atriz Ashley Judd enquanto ela nos leva de volta 150 anos para uma visão íntima das batalhas e lutas do Norte na Guerra civil.
Junte-se ao cantor de música country Trace Adkins, cujo ancestral lutou pelo Sul, enquanto acompanha a ascensão e queda da Confederação.
Junte-se ao ator Dennis Haysbert enquanto ele observa as lutas dos escravizados durante a Guerra Civil, através dos objetos da coleção do Smithsonian.

Conheça a história do P-51 Mustang, o caça que enfrentou a poderosa Luftwaffe alemã e venceu.
Acompanhe a história do jato Harrier de decolagem curta/pouso vertical e como ele provou seu valor no Afeganistão e no Iraque.

Reviva os ataques a Pearl Harbor por meio de documentos desclassificados, imagens raras e noticiários, muitos dos quais não foram transmitido desde 1941.
Revisite os L.A. Riots mostrados inteiramente por meio de reportagens, vídeos caseiros e imagens policiais.
De herdeira de um império de mídia gigante a criminosa procurada, testemunhe a estranha saga do sequestro de Patty Hearst em 1974.
Mergulhe no drama dos assassinatos do "Filho de Sam", apresentado da forma como os eventos foram cobertos na época.

O quase desastre da Apollo 13 foi um dos momentos mais devastadores - e melhores - da NASA.

Testemunhe as primeiras batalhas e as primeiras ondas de choque da Guerra do Pacífico, capturadas por meio de imagens coloridas raras.

Veja como a estratégia americana de pular de ilha no Pacífico quase terminou com sua primeira invasão, no atol de Tarawa.

664c8ba33d173b00080ef0c8: L’AMBB organise un tournoi pour désigner les membres de l’équipe nationale. La DNA arrive et interrompt la compétition.
Zyro et ses amis se lancent à l’assaut du QG de la DNA.
Zyro et ses amis combattent les bladers du QG de la DNA.
Shinobu l’emporte sur Baihu.  Shinobu, Zyro et Maru retrouvent Gingka.
Kira et Zyro combattent dans un stadium flottant. Mais un Doji robotisé interrompt l’affrontement.
Gingka, Zyro et Kira s’unissent pour vaincre Doji, et l’AMBB peut enfin envisage l’avenir du Beyblade.
Lorsque Kenta est contraint de participer à un combat Beyblade par quatre Chasseurs de Têtes et qu'il perd.
Avant que la nouvelle amie de Gingka, Madoka n'ait pu finir de réparer sa toupie endommagée Pegasus.
Kenta a peur que Gingka quitte la ville pour trouver des adversaires à sa hauteur.
Benkei est dévasté par la perte de son mentor Kyoya qui a été obligé de suivre Doji pour payer sa dette.
Gingka refuse de combattre un voyou obsédé par les crabes appelé Tetsuya Watarigani.
Les chasseurs de tête rencontrent Hikaru Hasama qui a juré à sa mère, il y a bien longtemps, qu'elle deviendrait le meilleur blader du monde.
Benkei entraîne Kenta pour que le jeune blader puisse affronter à nouveau et vaincre Hikaru Hasama.
Doji envoie Kyoya dans le Wolf Canyon où il devra escalader une montagne et combattre des loups sauvages.
Lorsque Kyoya revient de Wolf Canyon et affronte Benkei dans un combat qui s'avère particulièrement destructeur.
Kenta porte Benkei jusqu'au B-Pit. Benkei est très mal en point.
Doji arrive pour boire à la santé de la victoire de Gingka. Mais Gingka n'a pas le temps d'apprécier ses félicitations.
Nos amis se sont introduits dans le complexe de la nébuleuse Noire. Doji les informe qu'il les attend au dernier étage.
A l'intérieur du château de la Nébuleuse noire, Gingka est face à face avec son vieil ennemi.
Kenta confronte Gingka et Gingka finit par lui raconter son passé.
Kenta a trouvé une lettre de Gingka: il doit quitter ses amis pour quelque temps, mais il ne peut pas leur dire pourquoi.
Le difficile et épuisant voyage à travers les montagnes continue.
Le groupe arrive enfin au village de Koma mais Gingka n'est plus sur place.
Gingka vient de rentrer de son expérience revigorante dans les montagnes. Gingka se rassemble avec ses amis dans le village de Koma.
En travaillant sur les toupies de nos amis, Madoka découvre une faiblesse dans le Dark Bull de Benkei.
Le monde des bladers est en émoi: l'association mondiale de beyblade organise un concours exceptionnel: un combat de survie.
Le combat de survie continue et chacun se bat de toutes ses forces pour rester en lice.
A la finale du combat de survie, les derniers participants en lice sont Kyoya, Gingka, Madoka et Yu.
Yu est récompensé d'avoir gagné le combat de survie: son voeu quel qu'il soit sera exaucé. Mais Doji arrive avec un message.
Les matchs de qualification font rage. Nos amis essaient à tout prix d'accumuler des points dans le but de participer à l'ultime bataille.
Kyoya est frustré car ses adversaires ne représentent pas de vrais défis pour lui.
Doji et Yu sont à la recherche de bladers talentueux qui participeront à l'ultime bataille.
Lors de l'inscription à un match de qualification, Kenta retrouve son vieil ami Hyoma dans la file d'attente.
Watarigani déteste Gingka par-dessus tout mais jusqu'à présent, il a été incapable de le vaincre.
Au cours d'un duel stimulant de l'Ultime Bataille, Kenta rencontre un courageux blader appelé Sora.
Gingka, Benkei, Kenta et Madoka se retrouvent tous à un tournoi beyblade où le vainqueur remportera 10.000 points.
Alors qu'une nouvelle journée de Beyblade démarre, le Blader DJ annonce quatre combats simultanés dans quatre 'stadiums' différents.
Il ne reste plus que six bladers en compétition dans un des derniers tournois de qualification.
Madoka offre à Gingka un nouveau propulseur numérique qui calcule la puissance de propulsion.
Gingka est déterminé à gagner le moindre duel pour pouvoir participer à l'Ultime Bataille et vaincre Ryuga.
